name: Saimonji Touko
source: Having lived seriously as a career woman, she finds herself an unmarried woman in her prime, feeling like an extra. With endless savings, she quits her job and shifts to part-time work. Now, she starts looking for a man who can fulfill her needs.
translation: Having lived seriously as a career woman, she finds herself an unmarried woman in her prime, feeling like an extra. With endless savings, she quits her job and shifts to part-time work. Now, she starts looking for a man who can fulfill her needs.
